work_session_id.description: Defaults to the acting work session. Pass an existing session, including a delivered or abandoned one; work start and work deliver print its ID. An explicit session keeps single-session scope unless include_descendants is true.

include_descendants.description: Include only host-proven descendant work sessions. Defaults true for the current implicit session and false for an explicitly selected session.

source_incarnation.description: Required with result_ref or work_ref; copy from the original review.

result_ref.description: Exact result reference from a prior review. Use its result_detail_request, which also binds the original work session and source incarnation. Returns bounded retained transcript text, not reconstructed raw output.

view.description: Compact by default: current work and the recent attempts that failed and that worked. full returns every bounded attempt, work change and collected reference. Ignored for exact result or work-field detail.

work_ref.description: Stable work-notice RecordRef from the original review, not the transport ContentRef.

work_field.description: Required with work_ref and source_incarnation; mutually exclusive with result_ref. Returns this whole authored field, or an explicit refusal, never a clipped value.

description: Read recorded work without creating a task. Omit work_session_id for the acting work session; otherwise pass an existing one, which work start and work deliver print.
